description: CNAE-2025 (RD 10/2025, aligned with NACE Rev. 2.1), the version BDNS uses in sectores[] (e.g. 'S' = actividades artísticas). Sections with their division ranges, plus the divisions/classes relevant to Mecena's creators and cultural pymes. legacy2009 maps frequent CNAE-2009 codes users still quote to CNAE-2025.
